markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set; second model and all five neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, InSitu <1% | Overwhelmingly benign |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class, no ambiguity |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | No quality flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes, both Benign | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Score well below typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Score above typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Marked-pleomorphism score far below typical · Validated
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 7) · context · Below typical; poor spot check (8/20), not a reason [F3] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier use. TILs concept is weak (8/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Per-region probe scores regions 1 and 6 at 81% and 77% invasive, despite the benign whole-image call.
- Image is a simulated degraded resample (severity 3); reliability score ranks errors modestly (AUROC 0.69).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 6** — look for invasive foci; per-region probe risk 81% and 77%.
2. **Regions 5, 8, 9** — confirm glands show benign architecture, not in situ or invasive.
3. **Region 7** — check whether atypical cells are confined within ducts.
